name: M no Kokuin Dakenai Kanojo Netorarekei
original_name: エムの刻印 抱けない彼女 寝取られ系
source:
Mizuki "Sashy" Sashihara is the girl all guys want.
Her new boyfriend, the protagonist, is the luckiest man on campus,
and he naturally wants to get down to action with her...

But before he can......

He has to prove his love to her.
Can he give her the love she desires?
Is he just looking to bust a nut?

She resists his advances.
Love must breach the hellish walls of abstinance!
Pure love will arrive like a prince at the altar.

Before his eyes, however, her frivolities unfold...
Will he take off the blindfold and peek?

The ultimate taste of NTR will awaken the masochist inside of you.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ186479.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
